top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a genuinely new pharmacological principle, event-driven catalytic removal of a protein by induced proximity to an E3 ligase, which meets my game-changer test. The mechanism is quantitatively supported by ternary-complex structures, cooperativity and kinetics, and independent laboratories, and cereblon-directed agents already show clinical consequences. Crews, Deshaies and Handa fit the three-laureate limit with a mechanism-centred citation, though Ciulli's exclusion and the lack of an approved PROTAC remain real costs. P002 is the most mature and widely used alternative with a chemistry-defined citation but contested attribution (Rothberg, Ju, Mayer); P003 adds base editing, which is young and attributed to Liu alone; P004 rests on a principle whose in vivo scope is still contested and which is arguably biology; P000 is ranked last because several candidates are scientifically sound enough to award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; I have no connection to Crews, Deshaies, Handa or the other proposed laureates (Warshel-school methodological proximity to B007 is not in this slate).
